name: base_utils
description: Shared Linux utility module that optionally manages /etc/motd and installs a Hiera-driven package list.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Python application stack profile that prepares Python and database dependencies, deploys application code, creates a systemd service, and configures monitoring and logging.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load-balancer profile for installation, configuration, service management, firewall rules, optional discovery, statistics, logging, TLS, and multiple backends.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL installation profile that manages the repository, selected packages, version configuration, and service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis installation and configuration profile with authentication, persistence, memory limits, custom Redis configuration, and attempted PuppetDB-based node discovery.
